features.description: Emit the normalized architecture graph model (nodes+edges+levels+clusters+freshness) into the view-state the interactive SVG map consumes; keep architecture_levels write_levels as an OPTIONAL diffable .mmd export (cache-only, foreign-repo guarded), NOT the render source.
features.acceptance: The architecture build emits levels[] + clusters[] (by directory) alongside nodes/edges/freshness in the view-state; a test asserts the graph model carries them deterministically; the .mmd export still regenerates but is not the page's data source.

features.description: On the EXISTING interactive Architecture SVG: clicking a component highlights upstream/downstream dependencies + dims unrelated + opens the detail panel; a breadcrumb shows the level path and drills into the next cluster level and back. No mermaid runtime.
features.acceptance: Clicking a node highlights its upstream+downstream neighbors and dims the rest (pure dependency-walk logic unit-tested); the breadcrumb shows the level path and a cluster click drills in / root click restores; covered by page wiring tests.
